name: learning-engagement-capstone
description: Local Track 2 learning engagement proof of concept

scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings src tests tools vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests tools package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.server.json tsconfig.tests.json vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts index.html
scripts.format:check: biome format src tests tools package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.server.json tsconfig.tests.json vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts index.html
scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:client
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:process && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run audit
